guide_title.speaker: guide
guide_title.text: Welcome to Lucky Block Titans! Tap Play!

guide_welcome.speaker: guide
guide_welcome.text: Tap that shiny rainbow block right in front of us!

guide_starter_pop.speaker: guide
guide_starter_pop.text: Whoa! Lucky treasures! Let's plant our Magic Flowerpot!

guide_tap_pad.speaker: guide
guide_tap_pad.text: Tap a glowing garden pad to plant your Magic Flowerpot!

guide_try_chest.speaker: guide
guide_try_chest.text: Ooh! Tap the Giant Golden Chest for a surprise weapon!

guide_ready_moss.speaker: guide
guide_ready_moss.text: We're strong! Let's find the Mossy Titan in the meadow!

guide_ready_snow.speaker: guide
guide_ready_snow.text: Awesome power! Let's visit Crystal Snow Peak!

guide_ready_thunder.speaker: guide
guide_ready_thunder.text: Super strong! Let's bonk the Storm Titan by the farm!

guide_ready_king.speaker: guide
guide_ready_king.text: Ultimate power! Let's march into the Golden Castle!

guide_boing_hint.speaker: guide
guide_boing_hint.text: Boing! Too big! Let's spin the chest or plant pots first!

vo_drop_pot_seed.speaker: guide
vo_drop_pot_seed.text: A Magic Flowerpot seed! Plant it in the garden!

vo_drop_chest.speaker: guide
vo_drop_chest.text: Lucky! A free Golden Chest spin!

vo_drop_cake.speaker: guide
vo_drop_cake.text: Yummy party cake! Bonus shield heart!

vo_drop_piggy.speaker: guide
vo_drop_piggy.text: Oink oink! A bouncy treasure piggy popped out!

vo_drop_bee.speaker: guide
vo_drop_bee.text: Buzz buzz! A happy honey bee!

vo_pet_piggy.speaker: guide
vo_pet_piggy.text: Hee hee! Piggy loves tummy pats! More stars!

vo_pet_bee.speaker: guide
vo_pet_bee.text: Sweet honey stars! Thank you, little bee!

vo_pet_chick.speaker: guide
vo_pet_chick.text: Peep peep! Good job, sunny chick!

vo_titan_alert.speaker: guide
vo_titan_alert.text: Uh oh! That block is shaking! Surprise Titan!

vo_wpn_sword.speaker: guide
vo_wpn_sword.text: Cool! The Sparkle Sword! Chop, chop!

vo_wpn_pickaxe.speaker: guide
vo_wpn_pickaxe.text: Whoa! The Golden Mega Pickaxe! Blocks pop super fast!

vo_wpn_trident.speaker: guide
vo_wpn_trident.text: Amazing! The Ocean Trident! Splash power!

vo_wpn_hammer.speaker: guide
vo_wpn_hammer.text: Boom! The Vortex Thunder Hammer! Watch out, Titans!

vo_wpn_rainbow.speaker: guide
vo_wpn_rainbow.text: No way! The Rainbow Infinity Blade! Maximum star power!

vo_gear_boots.speaker: guide
vo_gear_boots.text: Zoom, zoom! Winged Speed Boots! Look how fast we run!

vo_gear_helmet.speaker: guide
vo_gear_helmet.text: Whoa! The Blazing Gold Titan Helmet! Rainbow shield hearts!

vo_gear_cape.speaker: guide
vo_gear_cape.text: Swish! The Royal Star Cape pulls in treasures!

vo_chaos_on.speaker: guide
vo_chaos_on.text: Lucky Chaos Mode! Every block goes super wacky!

vo_pot_glow.speaker: guide
vo_pot_glow.text: Yay! Our Glow Flowerpot is sprouting shiny stars!

vo_pot_crystal.speaker: guide
vo_pot_crystal.text: Sparkly! The Crystal Flowerpot makes double stars!

vo_pot_ultimate.speaker: guide
vo_pot_ultimate.text: Look! The Ultimate Star Flowerpot is raining treasure! We're rich!

vo_win_moss.speaker: guide
vo_win_moss.text: Hooray! We popped the Mossy Titan and won a Golden Trophy!

vo_win_snow.speaker: guide
vo_win_snow.text: Woohoo! Bye bye, Snow Wizard! Trophy number two!

vo_win_thunder.speaker: guide
vo_win_thunder.text: Zap! Down goes the Thunder Chief! Shiny trophy!

vo_win_king.speaker: guide
vo_win_king.text: We beat the Bedrock King! You are the Ultimate Titan Champion!

vo_finale_parade.speaker: guide
vo_finale_parade.text: Four Golden Trophies! Fireworks party! Wear your royal crown!

vo_keep_playing.speaker: guide
vo_keep_playing.text: Free play time! Smash blocks and spin for more surprises!

fairy_chest_open.speaker: fairy
fairy_chest_open.text: Step right up! Spin the Mystery Artifact Chest!

fairy_spinning.speaker: fairy
fairy_spinning.text: Round and round it goes! Which treasure will glow?

fairy_jackpot.speaker: fairy
fairy_jackpot.text: Ta-da! A legendary artifact, just for you!

fairy_bonus_stars.speaker: fairy
fairy_bonus_stars.text: Sparkle bonus! Extra star gems and shield power!

fairy_need_stars.speaker: fairy
fairy_need_stars.text: Collect a few more star gems from your flowerpots first!

fairy_pot_ready.speaker: fairy
fairy_pot_ready.text: Twinkle, twinkle! A garden pad is ready to bloom!

fairy_pot_fountain.speaker: fairy
fairy_pot_fountain.text: Starlight shower! Catch the shiny gems!

fairy_pot_max.speaker: fairy
fairy_pot_max.text: Wow! All four Ultimate Flowerpots are blooming bright!

fairy_shield_up.speaker: fairy
fairy_shield_up.text: Bing-bong! Rainbow shield hearts charged up!

fairy_welcome_back.speaker: fairy
fairy_welcome_back.text: Welcome back to Star Garden! Ready for more surprises?

titan_moss_spawn.speaker: boss_moss
titan_moss_spawn.text: YAWN! Who dug up my cozy mossy nap block?!

titan_moss_boing.speaker: boss_moss
titan_moss_boing.text: Ho ho! That tiny stick tickles! Bounce on my cloud!

titan_moss_ouch.speaker: boss_moss
titan_moss_ouch.text: Oof! Hey, watch my daisy hair!

titan_moss_defeat.speaker: boss_moss
titan_moss_defeat.text: Whoa-oa-oa! My mossy pebbles! Take my trophy!

titan_snow_spawn.speaker: boss_snow
titan_snow_spawn.text: BRRR! Nobody melts the Frosty Snow Wizard Titan!

titan_snow_boing.speaker: boss_snow
titan_snow_boing.text: Hee hee! Too chilly for a tiny stick! Boing-oing-oing!

titan_snow_ouch.speaker: boss_snow
titan_snow_ouch.text: Yikes! My pointy wizard hat is wobbling!

titan_snow_defeat.speaker: boss_snow
titan_snow_defeat.text: Achoo! I'm melting into candy stars! Take my trophy!

titan_thunder_spawn.speaker: boss_thunder
titan_thunder_spawn.text: BOOM BOOM! Who woke the Thunder Chief Titan?!

titan_thunder_boing.speaker: boss_thunder
titan_thunder_boing.text: Bwahaha! That tickles my belly! Come back with a bigger weapon!

titan_thunder_ouch.speaker: boss_thunder
titan_thunder_ouch.text: Zappy-ow! That weapon packs a wallop!

titan_thunder_defeat.speaker: boss_thunder
titan_thunder_defeat.text: Whoa! My giant thunder underpants! Here is my trophy!

titan_king_spawn.speaker: boss_king
titan_king_spawn.text: STOMP STOMP! Behold the Bedrock Crusher King!

titan_king_boing.speaker: boss_king
titan_king_boing.text: HO HO HO! You need a mighty hammer to bonk the King! Boing!

titan_king_ouch.speaker: boss_king
titan_king_ouch.text: Blazing blocks! My royal crown is spinning!

titan_king_defeat.speaker: boss_king
titan_king_defeat.text: Oooof! Pinata party! You win my Golden King Trophy!
